services.desc: The Florida Studio Theatre campus includes five state-of-the-art theatres, spanning two blocks in the heart of Downtown, Sarasota. See below for an overview of our spaces. FST's Keating Theatre is located on the corner of Cocoanut and North Palm Avenue. FST's Goldstein Cabaret is located just next door to the Keating Theatre on North Palm Avenue between Cocoanut Avenue and Tamiami Trail. Looking for a space to host your next training, retreat, or party? FST has ten unique spaces in the heart of downtown for you to choose
